responsibility: Defines the machine constraint language used by the Xstormy16 backend’s RTL patterns and reload logic. It maps single-letter register constraints to Stormy16 register classes, defines immediate-range and bitmask constraints for instruction selection, and provides target-specific memory/addressing constraints such as stack push/pop forms, immediate memory addresses validated by xstormy16_legitimate_address_p, and the special below-0x100 memory form consumed by the .md instruction alternatives.
